title: Make GrowteX Ventures site fully responsive for mobile and web

requirements.text: Make the Header component (Header.tsx) fully responsive: implement a collapsible hamburger mobile menu that opens/closes a full-width dropdown nav on small screens, ensure the GrowteX wordmark logo scales appropriately on mobile, and maintain the dark agency aesthetic with backdrop blur. Nav links and the 'Book a Free Call' CTA button must be accessible via the mobile menu. Touch targets must be at least 44×44px.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), the desktop nav links are hidden and a hamburger icon is shown
Tapping the hamburger icon opens a full-width dropdown menu with all nav links and CTA button
Tapping a nav link closes the mobile menu and smooth-scrolls to the target section
On desktop (≥768px), the full horizontal nav is shown and the hamburger is hidden
All tap targets are at least 44×44px on mobile
The dark agency aesthetic is preserved on all breakpoints

requirements.text: Make the Hero section (HeroSection.tsx) fully responsive: ensure the headline, subheadline, and tagline 'From Vision to Victory' scale down gracefully on mobile (smaller font sizes, tighter line-height), stack the two CTA buttons vertically on small screens, and disable or significantly reduce the parallax background effect on mobile to prevent performance issues and layout jank.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: Headline font size is appropriately smaller on mobile (e.g., text-3xl or text-4xl vs text-6xl+ on desktop)
CTA buttons stack vertically on screens <640px and display side-by-side on larger screens
Parallax effect is disabled on mobile (useParallax hook or a media-query guard) to avoid layout issues
Hero section fills the viewport correctly on all screen sizes without horizontal overflow

requirements.text: Make the Services section (ServicesSection.tsx) fully responsive: the service cards grid must display 1 column on mobile (<640px), 2 columns on tablet (640px–1024px), and 3 columns on desktop (>1024px). Card content (icon, title, description) must be readable at all breakpoints. Scroll-depth scale/translate animations must degrade gracefully on mobile (reduced or disabled).

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: Services grid shows 1 column on screens <640px
Services grid shows 2 columns on screens 640px–1023px
Services grid shows 3 columns on screens ≥1024px
Card text is fully readable without overflow on all breakpoints
Scroll-depth parallax animations are reduced or disabled on mobile

requirements.text: Make the About section (AboutSection.tsx) fully responsive: on mobile, the split layout (text + illustration) must stack vertically with the illustration below the text, stat counters must be arranged in a single column or 2-column grid, and the parallax illustration scroll effect must be disabled on mobile. Ensure headings and body text scale correctly.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), illustration appears below the text content in a single-column stack
Stat counters are displayed in a 2-column grid on mobile and inline on desktop
Illustration parallax scroll effect is disabled on mobile
Section heading and body text scale to readable sizes on all breakpoints

requirements.text: Make the Process section (ProcessSection.tsx) fully responsive: on desktop, display the 4-step timeline horizontally with connector lines between steps; on mobile and tablet, stack steps vertically. Step numbers, titles, and descriptions must be readable at all breakpoints. Staggered animations must work correctly on both desktop and mobile.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop (≥1024px), steps are displayed in a horizontal row with connector lines
On mobile and tablet (<1024px), steps stack vertically
Connector lines between steps are hidden in vertical/mobile layout
All step content is fully readable on all breakpoints
Scroll-triggered stagger animations trigger correctly on mobile

requirements.text: Make the Testimonials section (TestimonialsSection.tsx) fully responsive: display testimonial cards in a 1-column layout on mobile, 2 columns on tablet, and 3 columns on desktop. Cards must not overflow horizontally. Quote text, author name, and company info must all be readable on small screens.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: Testimonial cards display in 1 column on screens <640px
Testimonial cards display in 2 columns on screens 640px–1023px
Testimonial cards display in 3 columns on screens ≥1024px
No horizontal overflow on any breakpoint
All card text is legible on mobile

requirements.text: Make the Contact section (ContactSection.tsx) fully responsive: on mobile, stack the info panel (with phone/email links) above the contact form in a single-column layout; on desktop, display them side by side. Form fields (Name, Email, Company, Message) must be full-width and touch-friendly on mobile. The submit button must have a minimum tap target size of 44px height.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<768px), the info panel stacks above the form in a single column
On desktop (≥768px), the info panel and form display side by side
Form inputs are full-width on mobile with adequate padding for touch interaction
Submit button height is at least 44px on mobile
Phone (tel:) and email (mailto:) links remain clickable and visible on all breakpoints

requirements.text: Make the Footer (Footer.tsx) fully responsive: on mobile, stack the brand info, navigation columns (Services, Company, Contact), and contact details vertically in a single column; on desktop, display them in a multi-column horizontal layout. Social media icons must have adequate tap target sizes (at least 44×44px) on mobile. All text must remain readable with sufficient contrast on all breakpoints.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (<640px), all footer columns stack vertically
On desktop (≥768px), footer displays in a multi-column horizontal layout
Social media icon tap targets are at least 44×44px on mobile
All footer text (brand name, tagline, links, contact details, copyright) is legible on mobile
No horizontal scroll or content overflow on mobile

requirements.text: Apply global responsive typography and spacing adjustments across all sections: use Tailwind responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:) to scale section padding, heading sizes, body text sizes, and button sizes appropriately across mobile, tablet, and desktop. Ensure no horizontal overflow occurs on any screen size (overflow-x: hidden on the root layout if needed). Verify the ScrollProgressBar remains fixed and functional on mobile.

quotes: make it both mobile and web friendly

acceptanceCriteria: Section vertical padding is smaller on mobile (e.g., py-12 on mobile vs py-24 on desktop)
No horizontal scroll bar appears on mobile at any viewport width from 320px upward
The ScrollProgressBar is visible and functions correctly on mobile
Body text is at least 14px on mobile for readability
All AnimationWrapper scroll-reveal animations trigger correctly on mobile viewports

constraints: Preserve all existing content: 8 services, contact details (phone: 7999866007, email: info@growteX.com), tagline 'From Vision to Victory', testimonials, process steps
Preserve the Taggl Labs dark agency aesthetic (dark/black backgrounds, GrowteX green accent, bold typography) on all breakpoints
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
VideoPortfolioSection must remain removed from App.tsx
All parallax and scroll-depth animation effects must degrade gracefully on mobile (disabled or reduced)
nonGoals: Adding any new sections or content not already present on the site
Changing the overall visual theme, color palette, or typography style
Implementing a new mobile-specific design that differs from the desktop aesthetic
Adding native mobile app support or PWA features
